name: 中国风
description: 中国红 #8B1E22 强调，楷体标题，宣纸色背景，古典文化感，适合传统文化、国潮、中式美学内容

styles.h1: font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; color: #8B1E22; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.1em; line-height: 1.2; border-top: 2px solid #8B1E22; border-bottom: 2px solid #8B1E22; width: 80%; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #8B1E22; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.1em; border-left: 4px solid #8B1E22; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(139,30,34,0.4); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #8B1E22; line-height: 1.6; border-left: 3px solid #8B1E22; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 2; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 19px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #8B1E22; background: rgba(139,30,34,0.04); margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 15px; color: #666666; line-height: 2;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(139,30,34,0.1); background: #ffffff; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(139,30,34,0), rgba(139,30,34,0.5), rgba(139,30,34,0)); border: none; width: 80%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
styles.code: background: rgba(139,30,34,0.1); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 90%; color: #8B1E22; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
styles.pre: background: #faf8f5; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; border-top: 3px solid #8B1E22; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(139,30,34,0.1); color: #333333; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; background: #f0ece5;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 15px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(139,30,34,0.3);
styles.th: background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(139,30,34,0.15), rgba(139,30,34,0.05)); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(139,30,34,0.5); text-align: left; font-weight: bold; color: #8B1E22;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: rgba(139,30,34,0.1); color: #8B1E22; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.8; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #999999; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
styles.h4: font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold; color: #8B1E22; border-left: 2px solid #8B1E22; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #555555; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #888888; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
